topic: GTA VI launches today on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S after two delays
announced_at: Launch 19 Nov 2026; launch date announced Nov 2025 (Rockstar Newswire)
why_selected: Creator's request; it is also the broadest-appeal verified story in today's window: launch day, primary sources plus independent reporting.
research_summary: Rockstar's Newswire set Grand Theft Auto VI's launch for 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, after delays from fall 2025 and then 26 May 2026. Rockstar Support lists the Standard Edition at $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition at $99.99, and says digital pre-load began on 10 November and needs up to 212 GB depending on the device; Forbes and DotEsports report the same. Rockstar's own pages place the story in Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida, following Jason and Lucia. No PC date has been announced. Launch-day sales, reviews and server performance were not known at research time and are left out.
key_facts: Launch 19 Nov 2026, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
Pre-load from 10 Nov, up to 212 GB
uncertainties: Prices are US; other regions differ.
No PC date as of 19 Nov evening IST; re-check before recording.
Sales, reviews and server stability unknown.
context: Rockstar first announced GTA VI in December 2023 for 2025, then delayed it twice.
script:
GTA 6 finally aa gaya hai, aur iska download hai 212 GB tak.

Do baar delay hone ke baad, Rockstar ne aaj, 19 November ko, ise PlayStation 5 aur Xbox Series X aur S pe launch kiya.

US mein Standard Edition 79.99 dollars ki hai, aur Ultimate 99.99 ki.

Story Vice City mein hai, Leonida naam ki ek fictional state mein, aur aap khelte ho Jason aur Lucia ban ke.

Lekin PC walon ko abhi wait karna padega. Rockstar ne PC date abhi tak announce nahi ki.

Toh pehle storage check karo, phir decide karo: day one pe loge, ya PC ka wait karoge?
